lines.en: - What we need to focus on is how to destroy Peru,
specifically one person who lives there.
- Madam Ambassador, are you changing the scenario?
We didn't prepare for this.
- Global politics can change, and scenarios can arise,
and suddenly you're just like,
"Wait, I thought this one thing, but look over there.
That's a different thing, and it's changing everything."
And I'm like, "What?"
Hold up.
Who has tanks for me?
- I'm sorry, but we're gonna keep
trying to solve the food crisis.
- Food schmude.
This is war.
God, it's time for you to nut up Switzerland.
- Well, well, well, look who is brave enough
to show his face in Europe.
- Say the word, Leslie, I'll stick my army of lions on 'em.
- Okay, look, I think things are starting
to get a little out of control here.
- I agree, you betrayed me, and you went behind my back,
and now you need to pay.
- I need to, I need to pay.
- Do I stutter?
- Oh, okay, fair enough.
Oh, you know what, you might want to borrow this.
- Ew, no one wants your dirty underwear back.
- It's not dirty underwear, it's a white flag,
and you may as well start waving it right now, Leslie.
- The only thing I will be waving
is your decapitated head on a stick
in front of your weeping mother.
- Good Lord.
